title: Mara and the Passage
author: Z. M. Voss
blurb: Freya Dravenmoor, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
